Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Fishers for 2026, and here is what he found: 9 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Night Lights tree lighting and A Merry Prairie Holiday at Conner Prairie) through December 28, with the McCordsville Christmas Tree Lighting (December 4), Breakfast with Santa with Noblesville Parks (December 12) and Community Tea with Santa (December 19) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
